facts.fact: The plan's own text, issued by the Ministry of ICT, Innovation and Youth Affairs with a Cabinet Secretary foreword, says stakeholders jointly developed it and names no adopting act or draft status; read as adopted under the study rule for a published, undrafted government text. Publication date given as 2022-01-01 by the document record.
The full plan text is published as a PDF on the ICT Authority's official site (cms.icta.go.ke).
The plan states its period as 2022-2032 and says it will define efforts in the next ten years.

The plan carries a resource requirement per theme for each year 2022-2032 in Ksh millions (Table 6.1), and Annex 1 gives a budget, timeframe and responsible bodies for each key project, for example Ksh 118.0B for 52,000 km of government fibre in 2022-2030.

The plan names the ICT Authority as the main coordinating and implementing agency, chairing a Technical Implementation Committee and providing the secretariat and project management office, under an inter-ministerial committee chaired by the Principal Secretary and an oversight committee chaired by the Cabinet Secretary; a presidential-level oversight structure is also proposed.
